notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one Aura on the battlefield attached to a creature you control.
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional creature excluding the creature that has the Aura attached to it.
description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of any Aura you control attached to any other creature you control, then causing you to untap Yenna and scry 2.
